decisions.reason: As a recently launched multi-item line close to the firm's core skincare offer and given especially visible website presentation, management is likely to stay committed and treat the early period as too soon to judge failure.

The serum fits the established natural facial-care range, required development and launch effort, and in a growing market management would likely continue it rather than reverse course after only one year.

The cleansing milk is also close to the core business, so despite its lower visibility than Product A the firm would probably retain it because sunk effort, range coherence, and the option to blame any weak start on temporary factors all favor persistence.
